snippet.title: KUIPER ROULETTE IS NOW ON STEAM
snippet.description:
---LET'S GO GAMBLING!---
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2837070/Kuiper_Roulette/

Kuiper Roulette is an indie space-casino themed roguelike game inspired off of games such as Russian Roulette and inspired off the art style of planetball comics. The game consists of 28 cards (and more upcoming) that can be obtained multiple ways for better or for worse. The game guarantees hours of gameplay as all features can be accessed via achievements meant to challenge your luck and skill.
